Commerce.identitiesHelp: Choose a product recorded before or add a new name and base unit. Price is recorded with stock and sales, not with identification.
Commerce.availableItemsHelp: Items appear here after you record them inside New stock.
Commerce.availableItemsLiveHelp: These quantities are live. Sales reduce them, while voided sales and sellable returns restore them.
Commerce.correctAvailableItemHelp: Correct identification details here. Unit changes are restricted when the item already has stock history.
Commerce.unitCorrectionWarning: Changing a unit changes the meaning of historical quantities. TEED only allows a direct unit correction when there is no dependent stock history; otherwise correct it from the original stock receipt.
Commerce.stockCorrectionsHelp: Correct genuine recording mistakes while preserving inventory history. Received stock has a 48-hour correction window based on when it was entered into TEED.
Commerce.correctionClosedHelp: Normal editing is closed. Use Add late delivery for goods that arrived later; do not rewrite the original receipt.
Commerce.correctStockItemHelp: Fix a human recording error. TEED will reject a correction that conflicts with stock already sold, returned, adjusted, or otherwise used.
Commerce.stockCorrectionWarning: Quantity cannot be reduced below stock that has already left availability. Unit changes are allowed only when they do not rewrite dependent history. Every accepted correction is audited.
Commerce.lateDeliveryFor: Adding a late delivery to {reference}. It will remain under this stock and keep today’s delivery date.
